svg.aria-label: A tile of 34 by 10 small squares. The inner 32 by 8 squares, blue, are the 256 cells the block writes. A ring of 80 amber squares around them is the halo, cells that neighbouring blocks write. The 4 corner squares, grey, are loaded but never read by a 5-point stencil. A note says 340 loads serve 256 results, 1.33 loads per result, against 4 reads per result without the tile.
svg.text: A 32 x 8 block and its halo in shared memory
The block loads a 34 x 10 tile once; threads read neighbours from it.
256 cells written by the block (32 x 8)
80 halo cells read, written by other blocks
4 corner cells loaded but never read
against 4 reads per result when every
